verdict.rationale: Fin has real programmatic surfaces. These include the Fin Agent API, an official MCP server, webhooks, a TypeScript SDK that exposes some AI-content management (content import sources), and a Fin CLI for setup and helpdesk configuration. However, the orchestration endpoints (ask Fin, run a procedure, escalate) are Preview-only. Many UI capabilities are documented only as help-center UI workflows with no API equivalent shown, including building Procedures, guidance, escalation rules, testing, and Insights/Monitors. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for Procedures authoring, guidance and escalation-rule management, testing/simulations, and analytics/Insights; GA (non-preview) orchestration endpoints; a published OpenAPI spec for Fin; independent confirmation of UI/API parity.
